settings.nav: Show Callboard in the forum's sidebar

settings.public_interest_help: Off, only the post's author (and moderators) see who sent a request. Either way, the notes stay private between the author and each member, and no email address is ever shown.
settings.discussion_tag_help: Needed when your forum requires a tag on every discussion.
